Once a production is greenlit the numbers leave the building on schedules and call sheets and become identifiers, and a scene numbered 12 that plays after scene 45 is correct. See spec §4.3.

fields.name: directionality
fields.label: Directionality
fields.helpText: Whether the order of the two characters carries meaning. 'mutual' — siblings, colleagues — reads the same either way, so the same pair entered twice is a duplicate. 'a_to_b' is directed and reads A -> B (A is B's mentor), so the reverse pair is a different fact, not a duplicate. Tooling cannot tell these apart without being told.

fields.name: physical_evolution
fields.label: Physical Evolution
fields.helpText: Narrative summary of how the physical dimension changes across the story. The queryable stages live in relationship_state rows (pattern 3).

entities.name: relationship_state
entities.label: Relationship State
entities.description: The stage a relationship is in as of a story position. Latest-wins position keying (pattern 3, spec §4.5): the state in force at position P is the latest row keyed at-or-before P. The prose relationship_arc / physical_evolution fields remain as narrative summaries; this table is the queryable truth (G1, schema 2.2).
entities.subject: character

fields.name: scene_id

entities.name: scene_blocking
entities.label: Scene Blocking
entities.description: Physical staging of characters and movement within the scene, including the use of distance as meaning (absorbed proxemic_design in the 2.0 consolidation).
entities.subject: scene

fields.name: proxemics
fields.label: Proxemics
fields.helpText: How physical distance between characters carries meaning in this scene — opening distances, evolution, violations.

entities.name: staging_beat
entities.label: Staging Beat
entities.description: Ordered physical staging moment within a scene container — either a scene_blocking or an action_sequence. Exactly one of scene_blocking_id or action_sequence_id must be set. Replaces blocking_beat and action_beat (2.0 consolidation).
entities.subject: scene

fields.name: scene_blocking_id
fields.label: Scene Blocking
fields.helpText: Parent for general blocking beats. Mutually exclusive with action_sequence_id.

fields.name: action_sequence_id
fields.label: Action Sequence
fields.helpText: Parent for choreographed action beats. Mutually exclusive with scene_blocking_id.

entities.name: action_sequence
entities.label: Action Sequence
entities.description: Choreographed action sequence — fight, chase, stunt.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: action_sequence_character
entities.label: Action Sequence-Character
entities.description: Links characters to action sequences with their role.
entities.subject: link

entities.name: performance_state
entities.label: Performance State
entities.description: Modulation of a character's baseline profile, in one performance modality. Replaces physical_state and vocal_state (2.0 consolidation). The modality enum mirrors bundle intents so per-modality tools can filter states the same way they filter bundles. Temporal reach is governed by the persistence field — see spec §4.5, pattern 2 — the state is in force from its keyed scene onward.
entities.subject: character

fields.name: persistence
fields.label: Persistence
fields.helpText: scene_only (default): in force only for the keyed scene. until_resolved: in force from the keyed scene onward, until resolved_at_scene. See spec §4.5, pattern 2.

fields.name: resolved_at_scene_id
fields.label: Resolved At Scene
fields.helpText: For until_resolved states: the scene at which this state stops being in force (exclusive). Empty = still open.

fields.name: modulations
fields.label: Modulations
fields.helpText: Keyed modulation of baseline profile attributes. Physical: tension / energy / posture / movement. Vocal: pitch / volume / pace / articulation. When multiple states are in force, modulations merge key-wise, newest state wins per key.

entities.name: performance_beat
entities.label: Performance Beat
entities.description: A specific performance moment for a character within a scene, in one modality — a physical action, a delivered line, or a facial beat. Replaces physical_performance_beat, vocal_beat, line_delivery, and microexpression (2.0 consolidation).
entities.subject: character

fields.name: line_text
fields.label: Line Text
fields.helpText: For vocal beats tied to a specific line. Interim matching contract — superseded by line_ref where a screenplay is present.

fields.name: line_ref
fields.label: Line Ref
fields.helpText: uuid of the anchored screenplay line (G5). Authored from the script editor; re-anchors deterministically through split/merge.

fields.name: visibility
fields.label: Audience Visibility
fields.helpText: Chiefly for facial beats — how legible the moment is.

entities.name: dialogue_rhythm
entities.label: Dialogue Rhythm
entities.description: Conversational pacing and interaction patterns in a scene.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: character_environment_physicality
entities.label: Character-Environment Physicality
entities.description: How a character physically interacts with their environment.
entities.subject: character

entities.name: movement_choreography
entities.label: Movement Choreography
entities.description: Choreographed movement design for a scene or sequence.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: musical_theme
entities.label: Musical Theme
entities.description: Recurring musical phrase associated with a character, place, or idea.
entities.subject: project

entities.name: sound_cue
entities.label: Sound Cue
entities.description: A specific sound element placement.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: music_cue
entities.label: Music Cue
entities.description: A specific music placement and its function.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: sound_perspective
entities.label: Sound Perspective
entities.description: POV approach to sound — whose ears are we using?
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: voiceover_design
entities.label: Voiceover Design
entities.description: Narration / inner-voice approach for the project or scene.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: music_sound_relationship
entities.label: Music-Sound Relationship
entities.description: How music and sound design interact in a scene.
entities.subject: scene

entities.name: creative_decision
entities.label: Creative Decision
entities.description: A recorded creative decision with rationale.
entities.subject: meta

entities.name: collaboration_note
entities.label: Collaboration Note
entities.description: Notes for or from collaborators.
entities.subject: meta

entities.name: asset
entities.label: Asset
entities.description: A REFERENCE to something outside the file — image, audio, 3D model, model weight, document. The atomic unit that bundles compose. Versionable — supports asset version chains.
entities.subject: meta

fields.name: identifier
fields.label: Identifier
fields.helpText: Rooted, portable address of the bytes. @project is the project folder. Resolution is derived and never stored. See spec §8.2.

fields.name: size_bytes
fields.label: Size (bytes)
fields.helpText: Cached hint for staleness detection. Not authoritative — the file may have changed.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.label: Content Hash
fields.helpText: Optional and opportunistic. Never computed on open — hashing a project's assets would stall on unmaterialised cloud files.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.helpText: Freeform and user-controlled. There is deliberately no intrinsic-purpose field: what an asset is FOR is a property of the link that reaches it, not of the row.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.label: Parent Version
fields.helpText: Previous version in the chain. Null for root version.

fields.name: superseded_at
fields.label: Superseded At
fields.helpText: Set when a successor version becomes active.

fields.name: superseded_by_id
fields.label: Superseded By
fields.helpText: Forward pointer to successor. Auto-set on supersession.

fields.name: external_id
fields.label: External ID
fields.helpText: Optional. Identifier in an external system (OMC, EIDR, production DB, etc.). See spec §6.3.

fields.name: external_id_namespace
fields.label: External ID Namespace
fields.helpText: Which external system the identifier belongs to.

entities.name: asset_relationship
entities.label: Asset Relationship
entities.description: Links an asset to an entity it documents or references. Open polymorphism — entity_type is open-ended.
entities.subject: link
